problem_type: Dynamic composer controls collapse the prompt scrollport
symptom: PR #685 addNodeWithPrompt:177 fails: empty effect chips intercept pointer events; video prompt not visible.
direct_cause: The shrink-0 effect row consumes space while the prompt flex child has min-h-0; fixed 150px overflow threshold does not represent the dynamic content height.
class_root: The shared composer does not reserve a usable prompt scrollport when auxiliary controls grow.
affected_population: Image and video composers with limited placement height and dynamic effect/reference controls
entry_points: Image creation and video creation through NodeGenerationComposer
internal_only_reason: Internal flex sizing invariant; no SDK or protocol behavior changes.
invariants: Prompt scrollport retains three-line minimum; overflowing card remains scrollable.
generality_proof: Both image and video kinds render the same prompt flex child and card; CSS minimum height and parent overflow apply regardless of effect count or reference controls.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Own prompt minimum and card overflow together

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Shared PromptEditor branch and NodeEffectChips below it
Same branch with additional reference controls; original failure is video creation

recurrence.reason: Any viewport or control row growth can exhaust the flex prompt area.
same_class_scan: Read NodeEffectChips shrink-0 row and NodeGenerationComposer PromptEditor/card sizing
Read group-baseline editor click and canvas-batch-production image/video creation
Read useComposerViewportPlacement and composerObstaclePlacement: available height varies with obstacles

prevention.invariant: Prompt keeps its minimum height and card can scroll when controls exceed available height.
prevention.failure_mode: Overflow is scrollable instead of hiding the editable area.
prevention.strategy: CSS minimum on the prompt scrollport and overflow auto on its parent; remove fixed-threshold flex override.

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove zero-height prompt shrink and fixed-threshold scroll exception in the existing component.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No third-party API or version change; internal layout ownership.

migration: No stored data or API changes.
residual_risks: Linux CI rerun remains required after local macOS Electron acceptance.
